paper_title: Prospects of nuclear-coupled-dark-matter detection via correlation spectroscopy of I$_2^+$ and Ca$^+$
coupling_convention: dimensionless dilaton-type gluon coupling d_g (Damour-Donoghue normalization)
notes: Proposal paper (not a measurement): projects sensitivity of correlation spectroscopy between an I2+ molecular-ion clock and a Ca+ atomic clock to ULDM coupled to the QCD/gluon sector. Two projected results are given: (1) scalar gluon coupling d_g >~ 1e-5 * (m_phi/1e-18 eV) over m_DM ~ 1e-21 to 1e-14 eV (extracted here as the ScalarBaryon/d_g projection line from the text scaling relation, no table available); (2) axion decay constant f_a <~ 2e14 GeV * (1e-18 eV/m_a), which would map to AxionMass/gluon coupling and is not encoded here. Data points are reconstructed from the text scaling formula, not from a digitized figure, so treat as approximate. Local DM density rho_DM = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed. Assumed Ramsey time 0.58 s, one-month campaign, sigma_c precision floor ~1e-18.
